newsitem.title: UK: ABN AMRO ups Airtours profit view - sources.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO ups Airtours profit view - sources.

text.p: ABN AMRO Hoare Govett upgraded its profit outlook for UK holiday company Airtours Plc and kept its rating on the stock as a buy, market sources said on Wednesday.
The firm raised its estimates for year pretax profits to 110 million stg from 103 million after Airtours reported a sharp cut in first-quarter results, the sources said.
An ABN AMRO analyst declined to comment.
Airtours' first-quarter pretax losses declined by roughly 34 percent to 12.1 million stg.
The company's shares slid 6.0p to 970.5 by 1100 GMT.
